Module com.project.coursework2
Package com.project.coursework2.data

Class BookingsDatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
com.project.coursework2.data.BookingsDatabaseManager
public class BookingsDatabaseManager extends Object
Data-access layer for the Booking table. Provides methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and conflict-checking bookings. All queries use parameterised PreparedStatements to prevent SQL injection.
